text:
Thornbury Press has bought the rights to *The Glass Cartographer*, the publisher confirmed on 14 March 2025.

I was at the Halvorsen Book Fair when a joint press statement was released alongside a signed rights agreement between Thornbury Press and the author's literary agency. I read the document myself at the press desk. It sets out a payment of £420,000 for world English-language rights.

Marguerite Ellsworth-Vane, acquisitions director at Thornbury Press, led the negotiations. Speaking to me after the announcement, she said the press had pursued the book with determination and was pleased to have secured it.

The agreement covers English-language publication worldwide. Neither side gave further details of the deal when I asked.

Thornbury Press is now the book's publisher. Readers wanting to follow the title can expect updates from the press as the project moves forward.
